summary: Physics Lab geometry/scale capacity mining found no additional actionable source/test gap beyond retained #423 and existing chair/cart/evidence lanes. A first-pass concern that aggregate ValidationContract snapshots compare only resource counts and the outer lab envelope is already closed by the server capture boundary: PhysicsLabValidation.captureInternal() calls assertCanonicalRepresentationSet() before producing a snapshot, and that validator checks the complete direct representation set plus canonical primitive/object/component attributes, sizes, positions, orientation basis vectors, collision/query/touch state, transparency, MaterialDNA/ObjectGenome identity, and missing/unexpected components. Interior geometry drift therefore fails during capture even if the global envelope is unchanged. Retained #423's finite/no-execute conversion and derived-overflow fences remain the correct scale/contract head; do not create a duplicate per-entity-envelope lane.
evidence: Retained #423 exact head aad25ec8aeef7437ad0938ead2259a6e39f3670f already independently passed primitive-number no-execute and symmetric finite derived-output review for PhysicsLabScale/ValidationContract.

PhysicsLabValidation.captureInternal() constructs the canonical recipe and invokes assertCanonicalRepresentationSet(model, recipe, requireComplete) before counting resources or computing the aggregate envelope.

assertCanonicalRepresentationSet() rejects unexpected/missing direct representations, duplicate keys/WorldEntityIds, wrong F2 identity/provenance/material/object attributes, and delegates geometry to assertCanonicalPartGeometry().

assertCanonicalPartGeometry() verifies anchored/collision/query/touch/transparency plus expected Size, Position, RightVector, UpVector, and LookVector; assertCanonicalObjectComponents() applies the same canonical geometry checks to every expected ObjectGenome component and rejects extras/missing components.

Therefore moving an interior stair/ramp/furniture/component while preserving counts and full-lab min/max cannot produce a valid captured snapshot; the capture fails before aggregate compare. No Studio/contact evidence is inferred.
